definition: The rule was tested against this house and the house does not meet it. A failure is reported only when a test actually ran and came out against the house, never for want of a number.
basis: VISION.md section VII: "Every check distinguishes evaluated-and-failed, evaluated-and-passed". mcp_server/core.py, in the note check_measurements returns with every verdict: "A fault only counts as present when a test actually failed." and the same rule for a style's own constraints: "A constraint only counts as present (violated) when a test actually failed."
